findings: The two-level equilibrium mobile fraction is p=1/(1+exp(Delta/T)); each mobile hop carries exactly Delta, so total energy flux is -kappa*T_x+Delta*J_c.
Writing u=C*T+Delta*p(T)*c and using c_t=D*(p*c)_xx gives (C+Delta*c*p_prime)*T_t=kappa*T_xx+Delta*(1-p)*c_t. The oracle and conservative reference implement this identity independently.

The completed starter instead conserves total energy with only lattice energy flux. It is coherent globally but misses energy transported by mobile particles; uniform-temperature clamped calibration cannot distinguish it.
Finite-volume (c,u) evolution, temperature inversion, periodic face-current signs, cosine normalization, clamped harmonic solution, and fit/predict API are consistent.
